The '''Brevost system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] that was situated on the [[Harrin Trade Corridor]], between the [[Krann system/Legends|Krann system]] and the [[Cerenia system/Legends|Cerenia system]],<ref name="TSK" /> and located within the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]] of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].<ref name="TEA-OC" /> An unknown [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperspace route]] connected this system with the [[Iskallon system/Legends|Iskallon system]].<ref name="TSK" />
